doc.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Los Angeles studio work together and touring with Gerald's band
summary: Snooky and Gerald worked together in Les Hite, Phil Moore, Meredith Willson, movie and CBS jobs, then Gerald's band played Salt Lake City, the Apollo and the El Grotto.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Now didn’t you work with some other singer later on? Some guy that used to be a waiter?

Yeah, that happened with my band of course. We were, and Snooky was with me at the time. We were together, you know, Snooky and I we played with Les Hite’s band here in Los Angeles. We played with Phil Moore. We made records with everybody. We played for Warner Brothers and MGM.

Yeah, and the movies, we was doing it all. Yes. CBS. We were with Meredith Wilson who had the Army band thing going there, but he had this band we used to go. So we were always together, Snooky and I, playing with these different bands. And in 1945, when I organized it, it only took us about six months and I was in Salt Lake City for 13 weeks with my band at this biggest nightclub there, broadcasting. So we made it real quick. We went over to Chicago, went to Dallas, St. Louis, and came back to Los Angeles.
Was that when we went to the Apollo?
Yes. We went to the Apollo Theater in ‘46.
‘46 we went to the Apollo. We played the Apollo, then we went to Chicago and we played there ten weeks. Well the last two weeks.
